name: Askey SBE1V1K front light
author: Router Home contributors
description: Drives the SBE1V1K's RGB front LED (three PWM LEDs, red:status, green:status and blue:status) with any colour and brightness: blue = internet through WAN, white = through a mobile modem, yellow = no internet, red = offline. Needs the pwm-leds device tree (OneNAS tree, or the fix from OpenWrt issue 26099).
